findings.summary: User-supplied 'q' is concatenated directly into a SQL string without parameterisation.
findings.why_it_matters: An attacker can append OR 1=1-- to dump the entire users table, or use UNION SELECT to exfiltrate arbitrary data.
findings.fix_patch: rows, err := db.Query("SELECT * FROM users WHERE name = ?", q)

findings.summary: Unescaped 'name' is written into an HTML response.
findings.why_it_matters: An attacker can supply a name containing <script> and run JavaScript in other users' browsers.

findings.summary: 'host' is interpolated into a shell command run via sh -c.
findings.why_it_matters: An attacker can pass "; rm -rf /" as the host and execute arbitrary commands on the server.
